title: IdP attribute timing, RBAC v2 claim mapping, and audit gaps for Okta/Azure/Google/Ping
creator: Maya Patel
project: Security: SSO hardening & RBAC v2 rollout
description: Summary: Investigate and document IdP-specific behaviors that impact RBAC v2 claim mapping and audit logging completeness for Okta, Azure AD, Google Workspace, and Ping. Deliver a compatibility guide, automated conformance tests, and remediation work to close audit gaps (missing auth_context, transient attribute timing, nameID collisions). Goal: reduce production SSO support incidents by 60% for RBAC-related auth failures and ensure audit records include identity and assertion metadata required for compliance.
acceptance_criteria: Compatibility guide written and reviewed covering attribute timing, NameID behaviors, session re-auth triggers, and relayState handling for Okta/Azure/Google/Ping
Automated end-to-end tests added to SSO integration suite that simulate delayed attribute delivery and assert RBAC v2 mapping stability
Audit logging schema extended so each successful SAML auth includes assertion_id, idp_provider, authn_instant, nameid_format, and raw_assertion_snippet (redacted) in events
Existing RBAC v2 claim-mapper handles missing optional attributes by safe defaults and logs mapping fallbacks
Design doc + rollout playbook approved by Security and PM; migration runbook for tenants using legacy claim mappings
notes: Motivation: Several high-severity support tickets in Q4 and Q1 were traced to subtle IdP behaviors: (a) Okta sometimes emits group claims in a follow-up attribute query when session is still establishing, (b) Azure AD can change NameID format during a tenant-level policy change, (c) Google Workspace will drop relayState on certain SP-initiated flows causing post-auth routing failures, and (d) Ping has nonstandard authnContext URIs that our parsers ignore. These all surface as RBAC denies or missing entitlements and create incomplete audit trails.
tasks: Spike: reproduce delayed attribute emission for Okta and capture timing window
Extend SAML parser to persist assertion_id and nameid_format into auth event payload
Add fallback mapping rules for RBAC v2 when primary attribute (e.g., email) is missing
Write compatibility matrix and tenant-facing guidance for required IdP settings
Add SSO conformance tests to CI that cover relayState and assertion replay cases
Coordinate with Console team on exposing assertion metadata in admin audit UI
